row.notes: myteam-g2: Submits the player offer (validated earlier by FUN_140dbb690) to a driver: compares the My Team account balance (func 140bf51c0) with offer+0x38, finds the response row for the offer chance (offer+0x44 float x100 against the 12-byte rows at comp+0x3e8..0x3f0), seeds an RNG, rolls the answer delay, and posts a BankAccountTransactionMessage (vtable 14568d508, category 0x10, amount -offer+0x38) debiting the player team, then calls FUN_140db7e30 (store pending answer, comp+0x2d8) and FUN_140db90d0. Hook: offer+0x38 is the cost debited, offer+0x44 the acceptance chance.

verify.notes: V9022 Balance (140bf51c0) < offer+0x38 returns early; row scan at comp+0x3e8..0x3f0 stride 12 while chance(offer+0x44)*100 < row[0]; MT19937 seeded, delay = lerp(row[1],row[2]); message vtable 14568d508 with byte 0x10 and amount -offer+0x38; then FUN_140db7e30 and FUN_140db90d0 on comp+0x2d8. All as claimed; a second random roll (when chance < 1.0) decides accept, which the note omits.
